story.p2: That is why La Storia cooks the Italian way — tomato sauce, mozzarella, basil and olive oil, baked to a golden crust.

about.title: About
about.description: La Storia — a traditional Italian pizzeria in Chișinău. How we cook and how to order.

body.p1: La Storia is a pizzeria in the traditional Italian style. The menu includes pizza, soft drinks, alcohol for adult guests, snacks, sauces and desserts.
body.p2: Orders are placed online: choose your dishes, check out, and an operator will call you back to confirm. You can choose city delivery or pickup.

delivery.title: Delivery & payment
delivery.description: Delivery zones and prices in Chișinău, minimum order, pickup and payment methods at La Storia.
delivery.paymentText: Cash or card to the courier / at the counter on receipt. Online card payment is not available.

contacts.title: Contact
contacts.description: La Storia pizzeria in Chișinău: address, phone and opening hours.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How La Storia processes customers' personal data.

body.p1: When you place an order we collect your name, phone number, delivery address and, optionally, email. This data is used only to process the order and contact you.
body.p2: We do not share your data with third parties except where needed to deliver the order.
body.p3: The site uses necessary cookies for language, cart and session. Analytics cookies are enabled only with your consent — see the Cookie policy.
body.p4: You can request deletion of your personal data using the details on the Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.description: Terms for placing and fulfilling orders on the La Storia website.

body.p1: An order is considered accepted after an operator confirms it by phone.
body.p2: Prices are in Moldovan lei (MDL) and may include discounts from active offers. Payment is by cash or card on receipt.
body.p3: Alcoholic products are sold only to persons aged 18 and over, in accordance with the law of the Republic of Moldova.

agePolicy.title: Alcohol 18+
agePolicy.description: Terms for selling alcoholic products on the La Storia website — 18+ only.

body.p1: The “Alcohol” section is available only to persons aged 18 or over. Before opening an alcoholic product or adding it to the cart you will be asked to confirm your age.
body.p2: By placing an order with alcohol you confirm that you are 18 or older. The courier may ask for ID.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: Which cookies the La Storia website uses and how to manage your consent.

body.p1: Necessary cookies (always on): NEXT_LOCALE — your language; the cart is kept in your browser's local storage; the admin session — staff only; ls_consent — your cookie choice.
body.p2: Analytics cookies (only with consent): anonymous visit statistics, if enabled by the administrator.
body.p3: You can change your choice at any time with the buttons below. If you delete the site's cookies in your browser, the banner will appear again.

q1.a: Add dishes to your cart and check out on the website. An operator will call you back to confirm.
